Notes_and_Tips: Avoid soy products and all seafood completely.
On Monday and Thursday, follow vegetarian options only.
For late-night or social gathering triggers, eat protein and vegetables first.
Keep fried foods occasional as they trigger overeating.
Simple salads with cucumber, tomato, spinach, or sweet corn can be added at lunch.
Consistency with routine and yoga will show visible body changes over time.
